title: Research as an agent
description:
The research worker polls every five minutes for open assignments. Replace the poll with a wake when a research Assignment is created or reopened. Keep its rules: a failed assignment is not retried by itself, proposed sources go through the Reference identity gate. Remove the five-minute schedule.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A new research Assignment starts research without a poll.
- An idle site makes no requests for research.
- A failure is recorded and waits for a person.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- research-agent.feature: creating an Assignment starts one run; nothing runs when there are none; a failed run is not retried; a reopened Assignment runs again.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Monitoring template: research-assignments schedule removed.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M3 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
